description.zh: 由抽公因式開始，學會分組、恆等式與十字相乘。
description.en: Start with common factors, then learn grouping, identities and the cross-method.

description.zh: 由代入與消元，學會把價格、比例及路程條件寫成兩條方程。
description.en: Use substitution and elimination, then form equations for prices, proportions and journeys.

description.zh: 解二次方程、判斷根的性質，再認識複數運算。
description.en: Solve quadratic equations, investigate their roots and work with complex numbers.

description.zh: 從斜率、截距與垂直關係，找出直線方程。
description.en: Use slopes, intercepts and perpendicular lines to find equations.

description.zh: 分清「及」與「或」，逐步找出一次及二次不等式的解集。
description.en: Distinguish “and” from “or” and find solution sets for linear and quadratic inequalities.

description.zh: 先判斷次序是否重要，再處理排列、選人與插空題。
description.en: Decide whether order matters, then practise arrangements, selections and insertion.

scope.zh: 二次方程與複數、直線方程、不等式、排列與組合
scope.en: Quadratic equations and complex numbers, straight lines, inequalities, permutations and combinations
